name: chronicle-portfolio-client
description: Public site for Chronicle. Consumes the read-only API served by Chronicle.Portfolio.Server.
//: Transitive security pins for RUNTIME dependencies. next 16.2.12 resolves postcss 8.4.31 and
sharp 0.34.5, both carrying high-severity advisories; js-yaml arrives via openapi-typescript.
npm's own `audit fix --force` proposes downgrading next to 9.3.3, which is not a fix. Each pin
below stays WITHIN its major, so it is a patch rather than an API change. Re-check on each
Next upgrade and drop entries once upstream ships a fixed version itself.
Deliberately NOT pinned: brace-expansion. Its advisory is only fixed in 5.0.8+, but eslint's
tree contains minimatch@3 and minimatch@5, which need the v1 and v2 APIs - forcing v5 on them
breaks eslint outright with 'expand is not a function'. There is no version that satisfies
both, so this waits on eslint dropping minimatch@3. It is dev-only and production audits
clean; CI gates on `npm audit --omit=dev` for that reason and reports the rest for visibility.
